training_fitness.formula: arithmetic mean of J_GP_v3(i) / J_VNSME_v3(i) over exactly the configured training instances
training_fitness.smoke_scope: subset diagnostic only; not official train fitness
training_fitness.invalid_result_rule: invalid, timed out, unaudited or evidence-incomplete rollout has benchmark_J=null and cannot contribute a ratio; penalty ranks it only as invalid

selection.validation_policy: validation ratio first; then train fitness, node count and canonical tree

cache.policy: context-addressed; valid entries are re-audited before reuse; invalid or incomplete outcomes are never valid cache hits

resume: unsupported; trainer must reject resume requests and create a new output directory
sealed_access: forbidden; trainer accepts only instances 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and smoke rollouts use only 2 and 3
requirements: The combined VNSME v3 reference must pass its loader for exact IDs 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 before any rollout.
The draft official split remains train 2, 3, 4, 5 and validation 6; this smoke evaluates only train subset 2, 3.
No validation result is used by this smoke for fitness, breeding, tuning or selection.
The runner must receive the explicit v3 contract flag and must not start VNSME or Java.
Official training remains disabled by this protocol.
